description:
Fold it. Flick it. Fly it. Paper Pilot is a one-tap flyer where a little paper plane threads its way through a desk-sized world of giant pencils.

Tap anywhere to flap and glide through the gaps. It starts easy, then the gates tighten, the pace picks up and some pencils even start to sway. Fly long enough and you will watch the sky melt from bright day into a golden sunset and a starry night.

Earn Bronze, Silver, Gold and Platinum medals, chase your best score, and try not to say 'one more go' more than twenty times.
whatsNew: Swaying gates after 20 points, a smoother day-to-night sky, and a new Platinum medal for ace pilots.
